description: Disposable TypeScript expense-approval API used as the shared, neutral starting point for an independent, evidence-backed Rosetta evaluation.

servicesDescription.expense-approval-api: Fastify service for submitting, listing, reading, and deciding (approve/reject) expense submissions, backed by SQLite persistence.

sdlc.unit_tests: none (seed has API integration tests only)

vocabulary.expense submission: A request created via POST /expenses, starting in status SUBMITTED.
vocabulary.decision: The approve/reject action applied once to a SUBMITTED expense via PATCH /expenses/:expenseId/decision.
